items.title: Saxony-Anhalt: Far-right AfD eyes power in German state vote
items.description: Although the eastern state accounts for less than 3% of the nationwide electorate, the election outcome could serve as a bellwether about the far-right AfD's prospects in the rest of the country. DW has the latest.

items.title: Nepal bet nearly everything on hydropower - the floods show why that's a problem
items.description: More than 10% of Nepal's energy generation capacity was knocked out by last week's floods.

items.title: German company successfully launches rocket to space
items.description: Bavaria-based Isar Aerospace managed to launch its Spectrum rocket into orbit, 18 months after its first attempt. This is the first such launch from European soil.
